# Esha Ayur Care and Pharmacy

> Ayurvedic clinic and pharmacy in Byatarayanapura, Bengaluru, led by Dr. Gayathri S (BAMS, MD). Offers Ayurvedic consultations, therapies, skin care, women's care and weight management, with online consultation available.

## Key facts
- Name: Esha Ayur Care and Pharmacy
- Doctor: Dr. Gayathri S, BAMS, MD
- Address: Amruth Nagar Main Rd, opposite BBMP park, Sonnappa Layout, H A Farm Post, Amruthnagar, Byatarayanapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560024
- Phone: +91 98805 35528
- Email: gayathrimadhoo@gmail.com
- Clinic hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 1:30 PM and 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM
- Online consultation: Monday to Saturday, 1:30 PM to 5:30 PM
- Pharmacy: In-house Ayurvedic pharmacy

## Treatments
- Body and head therapies: Abhyanga, Pinda Sweda, Kati/Greeva/Janu Basti, Shirodhara, Dhara therapies, Netra Tarpana, Nasya and Dhumapana, Swedana, Navara Theppu, Panchakarma, Jaloukavacharana
- Skin care: Navara Facial, Kumkumadi Taila Facial
- Women's care: Yoni Pichu, Yoni Prakshalana
- Weight management: Udwarthana, Virechana, Vamana
